name: logger-jsonl
description: The logger@1 SINK `jsonl`: one JSON object per line ({sn,ts,name,type,level,args}) in a file, with bounded rotation. Structure instead of prose; never writes a resolved config.

level.description: Threshold: error | warn | info | debug (name or ordinal). Default info.

maxBytes.description: Rotate before a line would exceed this size (0 = never, default 0)
